title: The Rose Red
intro: A deep red envelope sealed in rose-gold wax. It opens on Bismillah and the two names above a lake at sunset, the date under a gold cover that guests wipe away, and the way to the venue.
included: An envelope that opens when the seal is tapped
Bismillah, and a welcome from the parents by name
The date hidden under gold, revealed with a swipe
Saved to the calendar in one tap
Venue with a map and directions
Your names set over the artwork, nothing repainted
